question: Can one simple, unguarded generated semantic board-move template both emit a legal candidate on fresh legacy-generated roots and enter the existing static movement-price projection?
changed_premise: The prior one-template screen added a slot-guarded persistent-bool effect, which the static profile intentionally excludes. This screen isolates a direct unguarded leap action with no auxiliary state or compound effect.
selection: Per seed, deterministically choose one generated non-promotable type present on the initial board, with emitted movement atoms, that does not already contain LeapAtom((1,2)); never resample a seed if no type qualifies.
template: augment that type with direct owner-relative leap offset (1,2), empty target, one move(source,target) effect and own_anchor_safe invariant; no guards, auxiliary slots or other effects.
measurements: static profile movement projection contains the new LeapAtom
legacy-versus-semantic board/hand price values for selected type
interpretation: A positive result establishes only a scoped legal, statically projectable template on the fixed roots; a negative result remains root/template-specific and does not refute the DSL. This is not evidence of value calibration or full generator coverage.
